church.subtitle: Who We Are
church.title: About the Lighthouse Group of Churches
intro: Loyalty House International is a Christian denomination under the Lighthouse Group of Churches. We are a Bible-believing, Christ-centered church committed to loving God, serving His people, and sharing the Gospel of Jesus Christ with the world.

We are a family of believers from diverse backgrounds, united by our faith in Jesus Christ and our desire to grow in our relationship with God. At Loyalty House International, everyone is welcomed, valued, and encouraged to discover and fulfill God’s purpose for their life.

sections.heading: Our Mission
items: To preach the Gospel of Jesus Christ
To promote the work of God
To organize crusades and events for the propagation of the Gospel
To plant churches and establish missions
To encourage, strengthen, and establish the Church
To train pastors for the work of God
paragraphs: Through biblical teaching, worship, prayer, evangelism, discipleship, church planting, leadership training, crusades, and missions, we seek to bring people to the saving knowledge of Jesus Christ and equip believers to serve God faithfully.

sections.heading: Our Vision
sections.intro: Our vision is to build a strong, growing, and mission-minded church where people can:
items: Encounter God and experience His transforming power
Develop a meaningful relationship with Jesus Christ
Grow through the teaching and application of God’s Word
Discover and use their gifts in the service of God
Build strong, Christ-centered relationships and families
Become committed disciples who help others follow Christ
Participate in spreading the Gospel locally and internationally
Be trained and equipped for Christian ministry and leadership

sections.heading: What We Believe
paragraphs: We believe that the Bible is the inspired Word of God and the foundation of our faith. We believe that salvation is found through faith in Jesus Christ and that every believer is called to grow spiritually, live according to God’s Word, and share the Gospel with others.
We believe in the power of prayer, the ministry of the Holy Spirit, the importance of Christian fellowship, and the responsibility of every believer to contribute to the work of God.

sections.heading: Our Commitment to Missions and Church Planting
paragraphs: The Great Commission is central to our calling. We are committed to reaching people with the Gospel through evangelistic crusades, Christian events, missions, and the planting of churches.
We seek not only to bring people to Christ but also to establish them in the faith, help them become mature disciples, and provide opportunities for them to serve God and reach others.

sections.heading: Training Pastors and Leaders
paragraphs: We recognize the importance of trained, faithful, and committed leaders in advancing the work of God. Loyalty House International is therefore dedicated to identifying, training, and equipping pastors and Christian leaders for effective ministry.
Through biblical instruction, mentoring, discipleship, and practical ministry experience, we prepare men and women to serve God, strengthen the Church, establish missions, and preach the Gospel.

sections.heading: Our Church Family
paragraphs: Loyalty House International is more than a place of worship—it is a spiritual family. We are committed to creating an atmosphere where people can experience genuine love, encouragement, fellowship, and spiritual growth.
Whether you are beginning your journey of faith, looking for a church family, or seeking a place where you can serve and grow, there is a place for you at Loyalty House International.

sections.heading: Our Connection
paragraphs: As a denomination under the Lighthouse Group of Churches, Loyalty House International shares in a global vision of evangelism, discipleship, church planting, leadership development, missionary work, and the training of pastors.
We are privileged to be part of a wider family of churches committed to preaching the Gospel, establishing churches, raising Christian leaders, and reaching nations for Jesus Christ.

sections.heading: You Are Welcome
paragraphs: We warmly invite you to worship, grow, and serve with us. Come and experience heartfelt worship, life-changing teaching, meaningful fellowship, and a loving church family.
sections.quote: At Loyalty House International, you can belong, grow, serve, and help advance the Gospel of Jesus Christ.

convention.subtitle: Our Story
convention.title: About The Homecoming Convention
convention.history: The Homecoming Convention began as a gathering of believers returning to the mountain — a place of encounter, worship, and renewal. Each year, thousands from across the globe come together at Anagkazo Campus in Mampong, Ghana.
convention.purpose: To gather God's people for worship, teaching, fellowship, and spiritual impartation under the ministry of Dag Heward-Mills.
convention.vision: A global homecoming where nations are represented, lives are transformed, and the presence of God is experienced on the mountain.
convention.impact: Past conventions have seen attendees from dozens of nations, powerful testimonies, and lasting ministry connections formed across continents.

firstLady.subtitle: A Word of Welcome
firstLady.title: From the First Lady
firstLady.imageAlt: Word of Welcome from Lady Rev. Adelaide Heward-Mills
firstLady.message:
Dear Beloved Church Family,

With great joy, Bishop Dag and I warmly welcome you to our Homecoming Convention 2026!!

What a wonderful privilege it is to gather once again as one family in Christ. To think that our brothers and sisters are coming from over 100 countries,  across every continent of the world, fills my heart with gratitude to God. Look how far the Lord has brought us! Truly, only the Lord could build such a beautiful family, united by His love and His purpose.

Whether this is your very first Homecoming or you have attended many before, I pray that from the moment you arrive you will feel at home. Homecoming is more than a convention—it is a joyful reunion. It is a time to worship together, learn together, pray together, and rejoice in all that the Lord has done among us. It is also an opportunity to strengthen old friendships, make new ones, celebrate the wonderful work God is doing through His Church around the world, and most importantly, sit at the feet of our father and Bishop for a fresh word from the Lord.

My prayer is that these days will be a time of refreshing for you. May the Lord speak to your heart, strengthen your faith, renew your vision, and fill you with fresh oil as you spend time in His presence. I also pray that you will leave with precious memories, lasting friendships, and a deeper love for the Lord Jesus Christ.

As you make your journey here, remember that your presence will be a  blessing, and we that we are truly looking forward to spending these special days together as one church family.

For those local to Accra, and the various regions of Ghana, welcome!
And for those making the journey by bus, train or plane, welcome!

On behalf of Bishop Dag, our family, and the entire Homecoming team, I say, welcome home!

May the Lord richly bless you.
With much love,

Lady Rev. Adelaide Heward-Mills
